capabilities: Toggle CSS snippets from a fuzzy command-palette picker
Expose one toggle command per snippet for hotkey binding
Enable or disable all snippets at once
Reload the snippet list after files are added, removed, or renamed
extras: Not reviewed by Obsidian staff; recommended installation path is via the BRAT beta-plugin installer.
intentEvidence: Toggle Obsidian CSS snippets from the command palette — no more digging through Settings → Appearance.
problem: Obsidian only lets you enable or disable CSS snippets through the Settings UI, so toggling snippets often requires digging through menus.
summary: Command-palette utility that toggles Obsidian CSS snippets on and off without opening Settings → Appearance.
